item.title: Series examines election systems in Pennsylvania swing county
item.description:
Bucks County, Pennsylvania, is a closely-watched bellwether in state and national elections – a swing county in a swing state. With support from the Fund, the Bucks County Beacon dug into the county’s voting systems for an ongoing series of stories that look at how the county ensures that elections are secure and accessible.
